portfolio.title: Portfolio Inputs
portfolio.subtitle: Set your investment parameters and simulate performance
portfolio.initialCapitalHelp: Your starting principal amount or lump sum investment.
portfolio.targetYearsHelp: Number of years you want to project portfolio growth.
portfolio.monthlyDcaHelp: Regular monthly savings or Dollar-Cost Averaging added to portfolio.
portfolio.monthlyWithdrawalHelp: Regular monthly cash amount planned to be withdrawn from the portfolio.
portfolio.dcaIncreaseRateHelp: Annual percentage rate to increase your monthly contribution (inflation adjustment or salary raises).
portfolio.expectedReturnRateHelp: Average expected annual nominal return rate from your investments (stocks, bonds, real estate, etc.).
portfolio.expectedInflationRateHelp: Expected annual inflation rate reducing purchasing power.
portfolio.usdRateHelp: Exchange rate between your local currency and the reference currency you want to compare.
portfolio.expectedUsdGrowthRateHelp: Expected annual percentage appreciation of reference currency against local currency.
portfolio.expectedReturnRateMonthlyHelp: Average expected monthly nominal return rate from your investments (stocks, bonds, real estate, etc.).
portfolio.expectedInflationRateMonthlyHelp: Expected monthly inflation rate reducing purchasing power.
portfolio.expectedUsdGrowthRateMonthlyHelp: Expected monthly percentage appreciation of reference currency against local currency.
portfolio.withholdingTaxRateHelp: A simplified estimated rate applied to the gain portion of a withdrawal. Confirm the current rate for your own tax system.

settings.title: Application Settings
settings.description: Configure the application language, currency, and AI provider, and review system information.

settings.aiAutoApproveMutationsWarning: AI actions can immediately modify your saved portfolio data.

ai.modalDesc: Generate inflation, exchange rate, and return expectations for your selected currency and fill the form in one click.

ai.getGeminiKey: Get a free Gemini API key

notFound.title: This page could not be found

hero.title: Is your money gaining real value as your portfolio grows?
hero.description: Calculate compound returns, regular investments, and inflation in one projection. See today's purchasing power alongside the future nominal balance.

ledger.label: Value check
ledger.note: The same nominal amount can buy fewer goods and services as prices rise. Real value makes that difference visible.

guide.title: Read a portfolio projection from three angles
guide.description: Compare return, inflation, and regular-contribution assumptions instead of focusing on one future balance. Results are scenarios driven by your inputs, not forecasts.

0.title: What is a real return?
0.body: Real return separates inflation's purchasing-power effect from nominal growth. A positive nominal return does not always mean a positive real return.

1.title: How does compounding grow?
1.body: Each period's return joins the balance and can generate another return in the next period. Small assumption differences expand over longer horizons.

2.title: What do regular investments change?
2.body: Monthly contributions increase invested principal over time. Compare different savings plans by adding an annual contribution increase.

privacy.title: Calculations run in your browser
privacy.body: Portfolio inputs and scenarios stay on your device through localStorage. Financial inputs are not sent to an AI provider unless you choose to use an AI feature.

staticCalculator.title: Interactive portfolio calculator
staticCalculator.body: With JavaScript enabled, adjust starting capital, regular contributions, return, inflation, withdrawals, and reference-currency assumptions to calculate results instantly.
